descripcion_geo: Land south of Jerusalem in the Valley of Hinnom, purchased with the thirty silver coins of Judas's betrayal.
importancia_estrategica: Burial place for foreigners; symbol of betrayal and blood money in the passionate narrative.

historias.titulo: The traitor's price: the field bought with blood
historias.descripcion: The priests return Judas' thirty coins and buy the Potter's Field to bury foreigners; It was called 'Field of Blood'.

historias.titulo: The death of Judas at Akeldama
historias.descripcion: According to Acts, Judas fell headlong into that field and his intestines spilled out; The place was named Aceldama.

historias.titulo: The fulfillment of the prophecy of Jeremiah
historias.descripcion: Matthew sees in the purchase of the field the fulfillment of the prophet Jeremiah: thirty pieces of silver for the price of the Lord.

personajes.descripcion: He gave Jesus for thirty coins; He returned the money and died in Aceldama.
He narrated the story of Judas and Aceldama before the 120 disciples in the cenacle.
He was chosen by lot to fill Judas' vacant place after his death in Aceldama.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: Field of blood: symbol of betrayal and the death of the traitor; the price of the Savior became the price of a grave.

judaismo.descripcion: The thirty pieces of silver: price of the prophet in Zechariah 11:12-13; price of the traitor in the NT.
judaismo.significado_teologico: The thirty pieces of silver: price of the prophet in Zechariah 11:12-13; price of the traitor in the NT.

cristianismo.descripcion: Mateo sees in the purchase of the field the fulfillment of Jeremiah and Zechariah: the money of rejection becomes a place of death.
cristianismo.significado_teologico: Mateo sees in the purchase of the field the fulfillment of Jeremiah and Zechariah: the money of rejection becomes a place of death.

historias.titulo: The field bought with blood coins
historias.descripcion: The priests use Judas' thirty coins to buy the potter's field.

historias.titulo: The death of Judas at Akeldama
historias.descripcion: Judas fell at Akeldama and died; the place is called 'Field of Blood' in Aramaic.

historias.titulo: Peter announces the election of successor
historias.descripcion: Peter tells the story of Judas before the 120 and proposes choosing someone to take up his apostleship.

personajes.descripcion: He died in Aceldama after returning the thirty coins.
Chosen by lot to complete the Twelve.
He gave the speech that led to the election of Matías.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: Aceldama is the memorial of betrayal and the price of blood.

cristianismo.descripcion: The price of betrayal (30 coins) fulfills the prophecy of the rejected shepherd (Zech 11:12-13); blood money buys a field of dead.
cristianismo.significado_teologico: The price of betrayal (30 coins) fulfills the prophecy of the rejected shepherd (Zech 11:12-13); blood money buys a field of dead.
